articles.title: ABP LIVE Doc Talk | Sleeping Pills: How Regular Use May Affect Sleep Quality, Memory And Mood
articles.description:
Sleeping is among the key functions performed by the human brain. The brain restores the body, improves memory and learning, and regulates mood. Despite being a seemingly simple method to treat difficulties with sleep, the use of sleeping pills is not always required and may negatively affect the natural sleep process of the brain.

How The Brain Regulates Natural Sleep

We all have our own internal biological clock in our brain, which controls the time we are awake and when we become sleepy. Besides, natural sleep is controlled by the accumulation of a certain chemical – adenosine. This substance causes the feeling of tiredness, which is also called sleep pressure. If we have good sleeping routines, our body uses this system, and we can fall asleep without any medication.

ALSO READ | ABP LIVE Doc Talk | How Psychotherapy Helps People Manage Bipolar Disorder And Mood Swings

How Sleeping Pills Can Affect Sleep

However, sleeping pills can disrupt these mechanisms. Most sleeping drugs reduce the activity of the brain or enhance the effect of some substances that induce sleep. Although a person is likely to fall asleep faster with the help of such medications, the quality of sleep may not be exactly the same as it would be without medication. Some sleeping pills affect the normal sleep structure, namely deep sleep and REM sleep.

ALSO READ | ABP LIVE Doc Talk | Cervicogenic Dizziness Explained: When Neck Pain Affects Your Balance

Regular or prolonged use of these drugs can also result in the development of tolerance, when a person needs higher doses to achieve the same effect. Some people may become dependent on sleeping pills and experience difficulty falling asleep without them. Stopping certain medicines may also lead to rebound insomnia, which is a temporary worsening of sleep problems.

Side Effects And The Role Of Sleep Hygiene

Sleeping pills may also have side effects, such as excessive daytime drowsiness, impaired coordination, lack of concentration, dizziness, memory problems, and slower reflexes. These effects can pose additional risks of falls or confusion, particularly among older people. This does not mean that sleeping pills cannot be helpful or are never needed. In some cases, doctors may recommend them to treat certain sleep disorders or short-term sleep problems when other approaches have not worked.

In most cases, however, improving sleep hygiene can be a useful first step. This includes maintaining regular bedtime hours, avoiding caffeine later in the evening, limiting screen time before bed, exercising regularly, and creating comfortable sleeping conditions in the bedroom.

articles.title: Yash's 'Toxic' Pre-Release Event In Hyderabad Turns Chaotic, Two Students Injured: WATCH
articles.description:
A mishap at the Toxic pre-release event in Hyderabad left several students injured. As per TOI, parts of the sound and lighting setup reportedly collapsed. A large crowd had gathered at the venue, with police deployed to manage the gathering and maintain order.

ALSO READ: Yash's 'Toxic' Eyes 12,000-Screen Worldwide Release; Actor's Second Film To Cross 1M BMS Interests

Students Injured At Toxic Pre-Release Event

During the Toxic: A Fairy Tale For Grown-Ups' pre-release event, some students climbed onto the light and sound structure. It suddenly gave way, resulting in injuries to students.

According to reports by Gulte, Police responded quickly and shifted those hurt to a nearby hospital for treatment.

#Toxic ప్రీ-రిలీజ్ ఈవెంట్‌లో ప్రమాదం 🚨

During the #ToxicTheMovie pre-release event, students climbed onto the sound boxes, which suddenly collapsed, leaving several students injured.

Police shifted the injured to a nearby hospital.#Yash pic.twitter.com/18MHy1cblq

— Milagro Movies (@MilagroMovies) August 23, 2026

A now-viral video shows several students climbing onto the sound and light structure for a better view of Yash. The structure suddenly gave way, sending the students down with it. People in the surrounding area quickly rushed over to check on those who were injured.

However, ABP Live could not independently verify these reports.

Yash Pauses Speech And Urges Students To Be Careful

The incident occurred while Yash was addressing the crowd. On noticing what had happened, the actor paused his speech and shouted, "carefully".

He then asked those in the affected area, "Is it okay there? Please students be careful."

Yash later checked whether everyone was alright and safe following the incident.

— TeluguOne (@Theteluguone) August 23, 2026

'Toxic' Advance Booking Report

Meanwhile, Toxic: A Fairy Tale For Grown-Ups has recorded strong advance bookings ahead of its release. According to industry tracker Sacnilk, the film has collected Rs 18.55 crore in advance bookings for Day 1 so far.

Sacnilk also reports that 12,585 shows have been scheduled for the film on its opening day.

Karnataka currently leads the advance booking figures with Rs 10.57 crore. Maharashtra follows with Rs 1.3 crore, while West Bengal has recorded Rs 88.13 lakh.

Delhi is next with Rs 86.75 lakh, followed by Uttar Pradesh at Rs 78.13 lakh, according to the same report.
